moodys.citation_text: Moody's affirmed CHLA at Baa2 stable consistent through 2020-2022 window. Downgrade to Baa3 not until May 2025 (out-of-window).

sp.citation_text: S&P historically rated CHLA in BBB range during window; chronologically consistent. _warning: starting notch not directly verified.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch rated CHLA in BBB range; inferred from peer rating chronology. _warning: not directly verified.

outcome_class_rationale: CHLA held Baa2/BBB ratings flat with stable outlooks across the window. High Medicaid exposure was a known structural risk but Provider Relief Fund and CARES Act mitigated 2020-2022 stress. Multi-year deterioration began later: May 2025 Baa3 and Dec 2025 Ba1 downgrades are OUT-OF-WINDOW.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: CHLA FY2020 (ended June 30, 2020) operating revenue ~$1.1B, $471M of rated debt per Moody's, strong philanthropic cash position. Pediatric hospital with strong donor base offset Medicaid exposure. _warning: figures inferred from Moody's $471M debt reference and peer pediatric AMC scale.
